description: Defines the MessageSendNotAllowedException class, a custom exception indicating message send failures due to permissions or non-existence of the target thing, including builder methods and JSON deserialization.

classes.name: MessageSendNotAllowedException
classes.description: Custom exception class for message send permission issues, with builder and JSON deserialization support.

classes.name: MessageSendNotAllowedException.Builder
classes.description: Fluent builder class for constructing MessageSendNotAllowedException instances.

methods.name: MessageSendNotAllowedException
methods.description: Constructor initializing exception with headers, message, description, cause, and href.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new builder instance, either from a string or a typed ThingId.
